hooks.command: "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/loom-python" --ready --script ../hooks/language-anchor.py; status=$?; if [ "$status" -eq 86 ]; then exec python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/language-anchor.py"; fi; exit "$status"

if [ -f "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/loom_checker.py" ]; then "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/loom-python" --ready push --hook; status=$?; if [ "$status" -eq 86 ]; then echo 'loom: publication hook failed (checker runtime unavailable; run loom-python --repair in an agent station); allowing.' >&2; exit 0; fi; exit "$status"; else cat >/dev/null; echo "loom: publication hook failed (installed checker is unavailable at ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/loom_checker.py; restart Claude Code to load the installed plugin version); allowing." >&2; exit 0; fi

"${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/loom-python" --ready --script ../hooks/language-anchor.py; status=$?; if [ "$status" -eq 86 ]; then exec python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/language-anchor.py"; fi; exit "$status"
